Explicit-cache creation tokens are billed at 125% of the standard input token price. Hits are billed at 10% of the standard input token price.

Implicit-cache hits are normally billed at 20% of the standard input token price. Explicit cache and implicit cache are mutually exclusive.

The `deepseek-v4-pro` cached-token price is not 20% of the input price. The explicit cache hit price for `qwen3.8-max` is not 10% of the standard input token price. Batch requests are not eligible for cache discounts.

Usage reports `cached_tokens` and `cache_creation_input_tokens`.
